geschichte.title: Founded from Conviction
paragraphs: KSK Farmos GmbH & Co. KG was founded in 2013 by Viktor Beresnev in Volkmarsen — with one clear goal: to give people with serious medical conditions the chance to live with dignity and independence.
Since then, we've been caring for patients across Hesse — in their own homes or in our residential facility in Kassel.
